result.guidanceOfficial: Based on strong commercial and operational performance year-to-date, the company now expects organic revenue growth of 7% to 9% and total revenue growth of 41% to 43%. Operating margin is now expected to finish the year between 13.3% and 14.1%, with adjusted operating margin of 20.2% to 21.0%, an increase of 80 to 160 bps versus prior year. EPS is expected to be $4.65 to $4.73, with adjusted EPS of $8.54 to $8.62, representing growth of 19% to 20% for the full year. The company expects free cash flow to be between 6 億美元 and 6.2 億美元, translating to a free cash flow margin of ~11% for the full year.
